comments.subject: Divario-New Neighborhood Park Request for Pickleball Courts
comments.comment:
To whom it may concern,

My name is Kacy Ambrosius, and I am a resident of the Divario community. I understand a new park is being planned for our neighborhood, and I strongly encourage the city to include pickleball courts in the park's design.

As a nearby resident, I can speak firsthand to the population this park will primarily serve. The surrounding community consists largely of older adults, with relatively few young children. From a community-use perspective, pickleball courts would be an excellent fit—offering an amenity that is accessible, active, and appealing across age groups.

Pickleball requires minimal space, is cost-effective to implement, and would provide a high level of ongoing use for near-proximity residents. Including courts would ensure the park meaningfully serves the surrounding community.

Thank you for your consideration.

Please let me know if there is a formal way for residents to show support, such as a petition or survey.

Sincerely,
Kacy Ambrosius

comments.subject: Public Comments Form
comments.comment:
My name is Lindsay Bayles, and I am a St. George resident. I am writing to express my support for the appointment of Jami Leavitt to the open council seat.

Jami brings strong judgment, a steady temperament, and a solution-oriented approach to complex issues. She listens carefully, treats people with respect, and has already taken the time to understand the key challenges facing our city, including growth, water, traffic, budgeting, and long-term quality of life.

I believe she would be able to contribute meaningfully right away and would represent St. George in a thoughtful, community-first manner. Thank you for your time and consideration.
